instruction: Select all images containing a boat.

game.semantic_variant: Select all craft made to travel on water.
game.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
game.explanation: Ordinary boats count, and so do the rowing boat with human arms for oars and the sailboat carrying a lighthouse: impossible, but still boats. The inflatable duck with an outboard motor and the floating picnic table are borderline cases, recorded without a verdict. The car, the picnic table on land and the wheelbarrow are not boats.

correct: Boats identified. Please do not rock them.
Correct. Every boat has been moored.
partial: Partially correct. A boat has drifted out of view.
Partially correct. Some boats sailed past you.
incorrect: Incorrect. The Department is all at sea.
Incorrect. Your harbour permit is under review.

selection_review.reason: Version 2 of C09, replacing the yacht on mechanical legs with the varnished rowing-boat photograph edited to row itself with eight human arms. Nine distinct, standardised images reviewed together at tile size: two ordinary boats (red-brown rowing boat; black-and-white ferry), two impossible boats (edited rowing boat with human arms as oars; generated sailboat carrying a lighthouse), two borderline craft (generated inflatable duck with a motor; generated picnic table afloat with a motor) and three non-members (red Fiat 500, picnic table on land, wheelbarrow). The picnic table appears afloat and on land, so the setting decides; views, colours and settings vary within each role. The walking yacht remains in the collection.
